digest_path.description: Absolute path to the rendered digest Markdown file (digest.md). On success, must be a non-empty absolute path. On failure, set to empty string.

references_path.description: Absolute path to the rendered structured references JSON file (references.json). On success, must be a non-empty absolute path. On failure, set to empty string.

citation_analysis_path.description: Absolute path to the rendered citation analysis JSON file (citation_analysis.json). On success, must be a non-empty absolute path. On failure, set to empty string.

literature_matching_metadata_path.description: Absolute path to the rendered literature matching metadata JSON file (literature_matching_metadata.json). On success, must be a non-empty absolute path. On failure, set to empty string.

citation_analysis_report_path.description: Absolute path to the human-readable citation analysis report (citation_analysis.md). Optional; only present when citation analysis was generated. Its content must match citation_analysis.json.report_md exactly.

representative_image.description: Representative figure selection result, based solely on textual evidence (captions, figure labels, Markdown/HTML/LaTeX image references, PDF page hints). Only include when a figure was evaluated for selection.

status.description: Selection outcome. Set to "selected" when a reliable figure candidate was found; set to "none" when no figure met the selection criteria.

source_kind.description: Source type of the figure evidence. "markdown_image_ref" for Markdown/HTML image references; "pdf_figure_caption" for PDF-extracted figure captions. Required when status is "selected".

label.description: Figure label from the source text, e.g. "Figure 1", "Fig. 2", "Table 3". Required when status is "selected".

caption_quote.description: Quoted figure caption text from the source. Required when status is "selected".

section_hint.description: Section name where the figure appears, e.g. "Methods", "Results", "Introduction". Optional contextual hint.

page_hint.description: Page number where the figure appears, if determinable from the source. Set to null when unavailable.

markdown_src_hint.description: Image source path from Markdown/HTML reference, e.g. "figures/overview.png". Required when source_kind is "markdown_image_ref"; must not be present when source_kind is "pdf_figure_caption".

selection_reason.description: Natural language explanation of why this figure was selected as representative. Required when status is "selected".

confidence.description: Confidence level of the selection. "high" for clear unambiguous evidence; "medium" for reasonable but with some ambiguity; "low" for tentative with weak evidence. Required when status is "selected".

provenance.description: Generation provenance metadata. On success, all sub-fields must be populated with real values. On failure, all sub-fields must be empty strings.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g. 2026-03-31T09:00:00Z) when the artifacts were generated. On failure, set to empty string.

input_hash.description: SHA256 hash of the input source file, prefixed with "sha256:" (e.g. sha256:0123456789abcdef). On failure, set to empty string.

model.description: Identifier string of the model used for generation (e.g. gpt-5.4). On failure, set to empty string.

warnings.description: Array of warning strings collected during execution. Empty array when no warnings were generated.

error.description: Structured error information. On success, must be an empty object {}. On failure, must contain at least "code" and "message" fields.
